rightsReview.reason: City of Kobe Transportation Bureau, Underground railway open data, weekday east/west Seishin-Yamate/Hokushin CSV, March 15 2025 revision; official city catalog uploads March 5 2026. Dataset-specific CC BY and full city policy reviewed; policy links CC BY 2.1 JP and the complete Japanese legal code has been read. Current operator open-data index independently identifies the same revision and CC BY 2.1 JP. Attribution: 神戸市交通局 / City of Kobe; source catalog and CSV URLs; licence https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.1/jp/ . Processed by TravelAssist into selected static station calling order, excluding clocks, fares and frequencies. Preserve attribution and licence; no endorsement or accuracy guarantee. Rights permit raw data, but this phase retains only minimal derived facts and source byte fingerprints. Independently inspect actual east data column 2 and west data column 3, each with all 17 station rows nonempty and explicit full-line origin/destination. Short-working preceding columns are excluded, not extended. Catalog Kaigan files predate the separate 2026 revision and are deliberately not used as current trains.
